finalText:
**Repeats are now dropped.** A key that just went out stays quiet for 5 minutes.

All 900 replayed with no errors. 99 repeats dropped, including critical ones.

| priority | day channels | quiet hours |
| --- | --- | --- |
| low | email | queue |
| normal | push | queue |
| high | sms + email | queue |
| critical | pager | pager |

A repeat exactly 5 minutes later still goes out. Only a real delivery starts the 5-minute clock. A dropped one does not.
